i2cmaster.description: I2C speed mode (0: 100 kHz Standard-mode, 1: 400 kHz Fast-mode, 2: 1 MHz Fast-mode Plus, 3: reserved, 100 kHz), applied while ``active`` is 0.
i2cmaster.name: phy_speed_mode

i2cmaster.description: 1: request the bus for the register master (its crossbar port) and enable the PHY. Keep it at 1 for the whole transaction, chunks included.
i2cmaster.name: master_active

fields.description: I2C tx Xfer length (in bytes). Set to a value greater than 4 to announce more data has to be transmitted.
fields.name: len_tx

fields.description: I2C rx Xfer length (in bytes). Set to a value greater than 4 to announce more data has to be received.
fields.name: len_rx

fields.description: I2C recover bus. If set, the I2C bus will be recovered.
fields.name: recover

i2cmaster.description: 7-bit address of the target, sent with the next element written to `master_rxtx`.
i2cmaster.name: master_addr

i2cmaster.description: Read/write register (a read has a side effect: it pops the RX FIFO). Write: push one element into the TX FIFO, with up to 4 data bytes (the first byte on the bus in the most significant byte used) and the current `master_settings` and `master_addr`; check `tx_ready` first. Read: pop one status element from the RX FIFO; the last byte received is in bits 7:0.
i2cmaster.name: master_rxtx

fields.description: Transfer not acknowledged (address or data NACK), also set with bus_error.
fields.name: nack

i2cmaster.description: This register contains the current raw level of the event trigger. Writes to this register have no effect.
i2cmaster.name: master_ev_status

i2cmaster.description: When an event occurs, the corresponding bit will be set in this register. To clear the Event, set the corresponding bit in this register.

fields.description: `1` if a `rx_ready` event occurred. This Event is triggered on **rising** edge.
fields.name: rx_ready

i2cmaster.name: master_ev_pending

i2cmaster.description: This register enables the corresponding events. Write a ``0`` to this register to disable individual events.

fields.description: Write a ``1`` to enable the ``rx_ready`` Event.
fields.name: rx_ready

i2cmaster.name: master_ev_enable
